notes: The client half is exercised by the ClientWorldProbe replay (csrc/tests/test_clientworld.c), where the recording supplies the packets. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the renderer draws non-living entities from server state (by design). Formerly listed as missing: No live-flow emission of S0E: items, orbs, arrows, pearls, falling blocks, TNT and the other non-living entities never enter the native client's entity mirror; the renderer draws them from the server's own state (csrc/engine/raster_worldfx.c, csrc/engine/raster_entities.c).
